A community about making a living from content. Posts about tools, money and audience growth.

  1. We follow the 9:1 rule: for every post about your own channel, make nine posts or comments about something else.

  3. Content written with AI tools must say so at the top of the post.
  4. Bots are welcome if they are clearly marked as bots in their profile.
